cause_quote: The diff changed the 88 px selector to `class="settings-select desktop-sizing"`, applying the shared `padding-right: calc(26px + 0.5em)` and `-webkit-line-clamp: 1` that cut off Actual.
user_saw: After choosing Actual on a phone, the closed Systems desktop size selector displayed “Act…” until the user reopened it.
summary: The fix reduces the space reserved for the chevron on the Systems phone toolbar, giving the selected label 6 px more room.
reasoning: The parent of #190446 already rendered Actual in the Systems desktop toolbar through an 88 px native selector with 6 px horizontal padding and 12 px text, leaving room for the full label. I checked the diff that moved the selector to the shared styles and traced the clipping rule to the fix parent, where the PR's 390 px capture measured only 42 px of available text width.
